story.title: Logging shouldn’t feel like a whole other job.
story.paragraph1: Most devs don’t have time to babysit a logging stack. ELK, random dashboards, YAML jungles — all just to answer one question: What went wrong?
story.paragraph2: If you’re shipping fast — junior, indie, side-project, or a small team — you don’t want to spend days wiring logs. You just want errors, requests, and latency in one place, instantly.
story.paragraph3: Frontend Monitoring removes all the overhead.
story.paragraph4: Drop in a small SDK, deploy, and your logs start streaming in under a minute. No servers. No cluster tuning. No 40-page docs before anything works.
story.paragraph5: It’s logging that just works, instead of becoming another system you have to maintain.

section.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don’t.
section.subtitle: Simple tools that help you see what your app is doing, without learning a new system.

capture.title: Capture & Store Instantly
capture.description: Send JSON logs from your app, API, or background jobs without schemas or migrations. We index everything automatically so you can focus on shipping.

search.title: Search & Debug Live
search.description: Find bugs in seconds with simple filters like status:500. Watch events stream in real-time with Live Tail to see exactly what’s happening.

stream.title: Live Log Stream
stream.description: Get a live stream of your log data directly in your application. Build your own custom dashboard views without needing to visit our website to check your logs.

alerts.title: Smart Alerts & Webhooks
alerts.description: Never miss a critical error. Set up alerts for specific events and receive instant notifications via webhooks. Track application crashes before they happen.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: How Frontend Monitoring collects, uses, shares, and protects your information.
Privacy.applies: Applies to the website, dashboard, SDKs, and APIs.

overview.title: Overview & Scope
overview.body: This policy covers personal information we process when you use Frontend Monitoring, including our site, dashboard, SDKs, and APIs. “Personal information” means any data that identifies or could reasonably be linked to an individual.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.item1: Account data: name, email, authentication profile, plan and billing metadata.
collect.item2: Product usage: requests, performance metrics, device/browser, timestamps, region.
collect.item3: Logs you send: messages, context fields, and metadata via SDKs/APIs.
collect.item4: Cookies/identifiers: session tokens, preferences, and analytics signals.

usage.title: How We Use Data
usage.item1: Operate, maintain, and improve the logging platform.
usage.item2: Authenticate sessions, secure the service, and prevent abuse.
usage.item3: Provide support, resolve issues, and communicate product updates.
usage.item4: Produce aggregated, anonymized analytics to guide product decisions.

rights.title: Legal Bases & Your Rights
rights.body: Where applicable (e.g., GDPR/CCPA), we rely on legitimate interests, contract performance, and consent for processing. You may have rights to access, correct, delete, port, or restrict processing of your personal data. We honor opt-out requests for marketing communications and support regional privacy requirements.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies for session authentication, preferences, and usage analytics. You can manage cookies in your browser settings; blocking some cookies may affect product functionality.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: Retention depends on your plan (e.g., shorter on free tiers, longer on paid tiers). You can delete logs or request account deletion through the dashboard or API at any time.

security.title: Security
security.body: We protect data in transit and at rest using industry-standard controls. Access to systems is restricted and audited. No method is 100% secure—please keep your API keys confidential and rotate them regularly.

sharing.title: Sharing & Transfers
sharing.body: We do not sell personal information. We may share limited data with trusted providers (hosting, email, analytics) solely to deliver the service, subject to agreements and safeguards. Data may be processed in regions outside your locale with appropriate protections.

transfers.title: International Transfers
transfers.body: When transferring data across borders, we implement measures consistent with applicable laws, including contractual protections and technical safeguards.

children.title: Children’s Privacy
children.body: Our service is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data. If you believe a child has provided data to us, contact support and we will promptly address it.

law.title: Governing Law
law.body: This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of the United States of America. Where relevant, applicable state laws may also apply.

choices.title: Your Choices & Contact
choices.item1: Access, update, export, or delete your account data from the dashboard.
choices.item2: Delete or export logs via API where supported by your plan.
choices.item3: For privacy inquiries, use the support channels listed in your dashboard.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this policy as the product evolves. If material changes occur, we will notify you within the product or on our site. Continued use indicates acceptance of the updated policy.
